text: 1100-g (2-lb 7-oz) newborn, 31 weeks' gestation. The patient was born three days ago with a birth weight of 1100 g at 31 weeks' gestation. speaker: Doctor
text: Given the history of chorioamnionitis and low Apgar scores, early-onset sepsis is highly likely. REQUEST TEST: Blood culture and CSF analysis.

speaker: Doctor
text: The test results indicating normal readings are inconclusive given the high clinical suspicion for sepsis from chorioamnionitis. REQUEST TEST: Lumbar puncture for CSF glucose, protein, cell count, and Gram stain.

speaker: Doctor
